items.problem: Bootstrap omitted externally linked UWP project inputs.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; MIDI.csproj linked shared App/MainPage/styles/assets while bootstrap copied only 9 local files.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap inventory was based on recursive directory contents rather than the UWP project's evaluated Include/Link inputs.
items.change: Parse common UWP csproj properties and linked Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items, materialize each at its Link path, include it in triage/mapping, and throw on unresolved linked inputs.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell code, XAML, styles, and package assets enter the migration automatically instead of being silently omitted and manually recreated.
items.falsifiable_check: Running bootstrap on the MIDI source reports 12 linked items copied, maps 21 total inputs, and produces App.xaml, MainPage.xaml/.cs, Styles/Styles.xaml, and Assets/splash-sdk.png in the target.

items.problem: The documented build loop used a nonexistent winapp build command and underspecified the dotnet alternative.
items.root_cause: Outdated command guidance did not match the installed CLI or Test-AppLaunch's platform-specific layout.
items.change: Replace winapp build guidance with explicit native dotnet build commands using csproj, configuration, and host platform; correct the related analyzer prose.
items.expected_effect: The first build runs from any working directory and produces output where the launch helper expects it.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun there is no 'build was not matched', MSB1003, or 'No build output found under bin\x64\Debug' diagnostic.

items.problem: The mandatory Step 0 commands were parallelized and raced.
items.root_cause: The prose specified ordinal commands but did not explicitly forbid one parallel tool batch.
items.change: Require separate sequential tool calls and success waits for scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check.
items.expected_effect: Bootstrap cannot observe a target that dotnet new has not finished creating.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun the first bootstrap succeeds without a Target not found error and the first self-check returns True.
